thread:
maya: hey team, found a `package.json` that looks like it was versioned by a dramatic poet: `0.0.0-rc.0.0.1` 😂
chris: that's... illegal in several countries and in semver land. :sob:
maya: exact CI error:
``
Error: invalid version: '0.0.0-rc.0.0.1'
 at parseVersion (semver.js:42)
 at validate (ci/validate-version.js:10)
```
aj: remind me why we still rely on human-entered versions. can we auto-normalize to `0.0.1`?
sam: if we do that, someone will insist we manually bump to `1.0.0` because they "fixed the docs" :face_with_raised_eyebrow:
deploy-bot: deploy failed: version parse error on release job. See logs: https://ci.example/release/8421 :x:
chris: poll: do we normalize, reject, or punish with YAML indentation therapy?
maya: normalize + small note in changelog. no punishments today. :tea:
aj: also found a `config.yaml` where tabs are used for indentation and someone accidentally added a new major feature by aligning a list item. i.e. yaml -> new API :grimacing:
sam: story of my life. one tab and suddenly `v2.0.0` is born. :tada: :sweat_smile:
chris: new internal policy: if your change causes a semver jump, you must write a haiku in the PR description.
maya: winner gets to pick the release notes emoji. :crown:
aj: fine. I'll write a haiku about YAML grief.
chris: anyone else want to see the offending `package.json`? it's short and tragic:
``
{
  "name": "widget-core",
  "version": "0.0.0-rc.0.0.1",
  "scripts": {"start": "node index.js"}
}
```
sam: bless them. also, can someone add a lint rule to fail on multiple consecutive dots in version strings? :pray:
maya: filing ticket now — tags: infra, ci, semver-therapy. i'll cc @eng-ops for the lint.
chris: :thumbsup: thanks. and if you see someone writing `1.0.0-alpha.beta.gamma` redirect them to this thread.
deploy-bot: reminder: next deploy window 6pm PT. try not to break semver before then. :robot_face:
maya: noted. also, tiny office poll: who wants YAML-themed cupcakes on Friday? :cupcake: (yes = :raised_hands:)
aj: yes
chris: yea
sam: yes
maya: great. it's settled. semver cupcakes and YAML frosting.
